adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/store.js.es6`, `_hydrateEmbedded` was changed so that on the singular branch it now does `delete obj[k]` (where `k` is the original `*_id` key) when hydration succeeds. The old code set `obj[subType] = hydrated` but did not delete the raw `*_id` field, so this is a cross-cutting semantic change for all rest-serializer payloads with embedded ids. The updated JS store tests (`store-test.js.es6`) only assert that associations like `farmer`, `category`, and plural `colors` hydrate, and do not assert whether `farmer_id`/`category_id` remain present, so the new behavior is unpinned by tests. The diff alone doesn’t prove a downstream break, but it does show a significant shared-infrastructure behavior change without coverage.
